subject.title: feat(subagents): native announceTarget for subagent completion routing (#27445)

question: Should `sessions_spawn` permanently expose the opt-in `announceTarget: "parent"` completion mode, where a successful child completion wakes the parent with `deliver: false` and never falls back to a direct channel announce if that wakeup fails?
rationale: The patch is a narrowly implemented feature rather than a correction to an established behavior contract; only a feature owner can decide whether intentionally suppressing individual child output is an acceptable supported orchestration mode.

options.title: Approve the narrow per-spawn mode
options.body: Accept the explicit parent-only route as a caller-selected fan-in primitive, with its existing persistence and no-channel-fallback semantics.

options.title: Defer native parent-only routing
options.body: Keep the existing completion policy and redesign orchestration delivery later if maintainers do not want this public model-tool capability.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow per-spawn mode
recommendation.body: Accept the explicit parent-only route as a caller-selected fan-in primitive, with its existing persistence and no-channel-fallback semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work covers the tool, session handoff, and subagent lifecycle boundaries whose product contract this PR changes.
